credential_fields.label: Client ID
credential_fields.tip: In Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials, click Create Credentials → OAuth client ID (Application type: Web application). The Client ID ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com.

credential_fields.label: Client Secret
credential_fields.tip: On the same OAuth client in Google Cloud Console, open the client and copy its Client Secret. Keep it private — treat it like a password.

setup_hint: Create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID (type: Web application) and paste the exact Redirect URI shown below into its "Authorized redirect URIs".
